topic: Data pipeline debugging and deployment status
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on debugging data pipelines, specifically concerning the use of `facility.data` versus `asset.data`. It was noted that a recent recalculation caused issues with `facility.data` across various scripts.

Multiple participants discussed deployment status and code changes. One participant confirmed having updated the staging environment after initial failures were observed. Another participant reported an issue where their fix did not appear on the stage, which was later resolved by updating the stage again.

Regarding data integrity, it was confirmed that AFA (presumably a client or system) data for the last week, including yesterday, is normal in production. The general consensus was to proceed with confirming the status of the pipeline.
decisions: AFA data for the last week (including yesterday) is considered normal in production.
action_items: Participants need to ensure all code changes are pushed to the repository and deployed correctly, especially to staging.
